title: feat(cnttab): occupancy first-wave 6-mask is all-six; seed-content mask is +e1 only
science: Register shift: synchronous FORMATION-TICK, not Dijkstra. On the origin-plus-six-NN star the axioms' own L1 occupancy rule (n=d/3, fire iff n!=0) forms all six neighbours at tick 1, mask (1,1,1,1,1,1); a named seed-content NN rule forms only +e1, mask (1,0,0,0,0,0). On B_3(0) the occupancy formation-tick gives t(1,0,0)=1, t(1,1,1)=3, t(2,0,0)=2, t(1,1,0)=2, so BOTH reverse and face bits are FALSE; under content-NN both are UNDEFINED (the sites never form). Independent third confirmation that the axiom-native register carries neither bit.
verdict_pair: reverse=occupancy FALSE / content UNDEFINED; face=occupancy FALSE / content UNDEFINED (formation-tick bits, not family verdicts)
